word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Brainstorm Communities

conceptHeader.description: A self-curating online community on nostr. Each participant maintains a personal record of the community (metadata plus engine config). Membership is determined algorithmically from member-issued endorsements and vetoes via the GR Community scoring system; no single party owns or controls the community. See feat/communities/PLAN.md §3 for design.
